## AddFlag {#addflag}

```lua
AddFlag(name, pos, heading, kind, kind2) -> number
```

| # | Argument | Read as | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `name` | string | Flag name (the scripts use names like `fP1_01`); `FindFlag` looks flags up by it. |
| 2 | `pos` | table of 3 numbers (t[1]..t[3]) | World position `{x, y, z}` in metres. Written back unchanged. |
| 3 | `heading` | number (single precision) | Facing in degrees (the scripts pass values such as 45, 89, 270), used when a human is placed at or uses the flag. |
| 4 | `kind` | number, truncated to an integer | Integer stored with the flag (16-bit); scripts usually pass 0. Meaning not traced. |
| 5 | `kind2` | number, truncated to an integer | Second integer stored with the flag (16-bit); usually 0. |

**Returns** number: Handle of the new flag.

Creates a flag: a named marker point with a facing, used as a spawn point, waypoint, objective or interaction point.
Levels create thousands of them.

**Notes.** Callee 0x00415c18 → 0x00415b68 (a flag from the flag pool, 0x00415af0, initialised by 0x00415e70 with
NilHandle as owner).

## AddPath {#addpath}


| # | Argument | Read as | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| 2 | `flags` | table of 8 numbers (t[1]..t[8]) | Exactly eight flag handles `{f1, ..., f8}` in order; NilHandle entries are skipped. Written back unchanged. |

the AI slice.

## AddVolumeBox {#addvolumebox}

```lua
AddVolumeBox(name, kind, corner, size, enable, flags) -> number
```

| # | Argument | Read as | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `name` | string | Box name, for scripts' own reference (such as `vFinishLine`). |
| 2 | `kind` | number, truncated to an integer | Box kind: 0 a plain trigger box, 2 another pooled kind, 3 a kind made by a factory (the turf boxes use 3); 1 is refused and returns NilHandle. |
| 3 | `corner` | table of 3 numbers (t[1]..t[3]) | Minimum corner `{x, y, z}` in world metres. Written back unchanged. |
| 4 | `size` | table of 3 numbers (t[1]..t[3]) | Extent `{dx, dy, dz}` in metres, added to the corner to give the opposite corner. Written back unchanged. |
| 5 | `enable` | boolean (nil or 0 is false); default true | True (default) creates the box enabled. |
| 6 | `flags` | number, truncated to an unsigned integer | Byte stored in the box (+0x6a); the scripts never pass it. Meaning not traced. |

**Returns** number: Handle of the box, or NilHandle for kind 1 (and possibly when a pool is empty).

Creates an axis-aligned volume box, used to test whether characters are inside an area (`IsInsideBox`), to switch
collision (`ChangeCollision`) and to mark turf.

**Notes.** Kinds 0 and 2 come from two pools (0x0051483c, 0x00514814); kind 3 from the factory at 0x00514834. What
distinguishes the kinds in play is not traced. Rotate the box about the vertical axis with `RotateVolumeBox`.

- **Evidence:** confirmed (code) at `0x004125b8`; detail: traced
- **Wrapper** `0x0037ac70` (registered by `RegisterBindings`); **calls** `0x004125b8` `VolumeBox_Add`
- **Used by** 53 of 467 script chunks (974 references); boot to menu: no; mission 1: yes; result used: yes
- **Coney:** not implemented

stored values.

Used when the arguments do not fit the first form (argument 1 a number, 2-3 numbers or absent, 4-5 booleans or absent,
nothing after 5). Starts the traversal with default settings.
